BiblicalUsage: Nedabiah is named once, among the sons of Jeconiah in the line of David after the captivity. He stands in the line of the captive king, where the promise runs through the exile.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the line is kept name by name: Nedabiah stands in the genealogy of the captive king, and the promise runs through the exile as surely as through the throne.
